name: comet-card

frames.best_why: The card is tilted toward the viewer with the white glare bloom sitting mid-photo and the pointer visible.

tagline: A portrait card tips in 3D and a white glare follows the cursor.
summary: A dark portrait card that leans and shifts in 3D under the pointer while a soft white spotlight trails across its surface and the frame lifts slightly.
appearance: A narrow dark card holds a portrait photo of a head against a blue backdrop, with a small mono footer reading 'Comet Invitation' and '#F7RA'. The card floats on black with a heavy soft shadow.
behaviour: As the pointer moves over the card it tilts toward the cursor, slides a little the same way, scales up and lifts, while a white radial glare tracks the pointer. Leaving settles it flat.
demo_content: A portrait photo, footer 'Comet Invitation' and code '#F7RA'.
search_phrases: card that tilts with the mouse
premium card hover for a portfolio
use_when: A single featured card such as a portrait, invite or product should feel physical under the pointer.
avoid_when: Hover-only: touch and keyboard users never get the tilt, and the glare needs a darker card to read well.
customise: Wrap any card as children and set rotateDepth, translateDepth and className; the glare size, shadow and hover scale are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One card with a handful of springs driven by pointer movement.

a11y.note: The tilt and glare are pointer-only, and the hover scale ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The glare blows out to near-white, hiding the photo where the pointer sits.
polish_why: Crisp tilt and believable depth; the glare can bleach the photo under the cursor.
title: Comet Card
